boundary: The subtrait's source-level name is not in the binary (PR #3171's boundary stands): no string or panic Location names it, and the group bodies are generic glue.  What this packet adds is the per-slot semantics of its groups, not the name.

Two of the recurring group keys (at .rodata 0x4503e0 and 0x454c30) are not the TypeId constant of the group's accessor type, nor of any vtable in the binary: the type they name has no dyn vtable here, so the probe's target type for those two roles is identified only by its shared 16-byte key constant.

The last group's sixth slot is the vtable's boundary cell: the measured extent ends there, and the cell holds the next header's drop pointer, a code address with no FDE record, or zero, depending on the member.  It is recorded as a boundary cell, not classified as a group body.

Virtual call sites of the group slots cannot be attributed by displacement alone: the offsets 0x60.. are used by hundreds of unrelated bodies calling through other vtables, so no caller census is claimed.

group_slots: accessor (12 bytes): returns (self+0x38, the group's dyn Error vtable A) - the field at +0x38 viewed as the group's accessor type
pair return (11 bytes): returns (self, the group's dyn Error vtable B) - self viewed as the group's pair type; for exactly one group per member B is the member's own vtable

keyed lookup (33 bytes): byte-compares the 16-byte key pointed to by the second argument against the group's constant; returns self+0x38 on equality, null otherwise.  The constant is the accessor type's TypeId in all but two roles
drop shim: drop-in-place for an object of the pair type B (Once-guarded array field at +0x10, element size 0x38) plus dealloc with B's size; the freed size equals B's size in all 47 groups
zero (3 bytes): xor eax,eax; ret - one shared body per member returning 0

drop shim for the NEXT group's pair type, in one of several variants (array-only, second-state check, buffer free, field drop, fat-pair drop, or a call to that type's own vtable drop body); in all 38 non-terminal cases it frees exactly that type's size or calls its drop.  The last group's sixth slot is the vtable boundary cell
family_layout.own_method_0x58: a drop shim for the first group's pair type: drops the Once-guarded array field at +0x10 (and, in the fuller variant, frees the (size, ptr) buffer at +0x38/+0x40), then frees the object with that type's size; the freed size equals the first pair size in all 8 members
